name: responsibility_transfers
description: A responsible administrator's proposal to hand company responsibility to another active administrator; it takes effect only when that successor accepts.
lifecycle: Created PENDING; becomes ACCEPTED, DECLINED by the successor, CANCELLED by the proposer, or EXPIRED after seven days. Retained for attribution; no runtime deletion.

columns.Meaning: Company whose responsibility would move; immutable (tenant key).
Membership of the responsible administrator who proposed the transfer.
Membership of the proposed successor, who must still be an active company administrator when accepting.
PENDING until the successor accepts or declines, the proposer cancels, or the proposal expires.
Instant after which the pending proposal can no longer be accepted.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the proposal stopped being pending.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A transfer belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, from_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The proposer is a membership of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, to_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The successor is a membership of the same company.
A decision instant exists exactly for proposals that are no longer pending.
A responsible administrator cannot propose themselves.
A proposal expires after it was made.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX responsibility_transfers_company_id_id_key ON public.responsibility_transfers USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key for future references to transfers.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX responsibility_transfers_one_pending ON public.responsibility_transfers USING btree (company_id) WHERE (status = 'PENDING'::"ResponsibilityTransferStatus")
constraints.Purpose: At most one pending transfer per company, including racing proposals.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX responsibility_transfers_successor_idx ON public.responsibility_transfers USING btree (company_id, to_membership_id)
constraints.Purpose: Supports finding the proposals addressed to a successor.
